_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Engineering Documentation Information
summary: The Engineering Documentation Information DID defines four record types (Document Description Record, Part Description Record, Structure Record, and Manufacturer's Description Record) used to build an engineering data base.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Engineering Documentation Information contains four distinct types of records. They are the Document Description Record (DDR), the Part Description Record (PDR), the Structure Record (STR) and the Manufacturer's Description Record (MDR).

3.2 The Engineering Documentation Information is used to build an engineering data base.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for these data included in the contract.

7.2 This DID is applicable to the acquisition of systems and equipments.

7.3 This DID supersedes DI-E-5331D.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: One DDR shall be prepared for each drawing, (assembly, subassembly, or part), standard, or other documents used in the fabrication or maintenance of the equipment.
One PDR shall be prepared for each assembly or part.
children.content: PDR shall not be prepared for reference documents.

children.title: One STR shall be prepared for each application of each item used in the fabrication, operation, or maintenance of the equipment.

At least one MDR shall be prepared for any part or assembly that is an Altered Item (TYPDWG=A in the DDR), Selected Item (TYPDWG=V in the DDR), Source Control (TYPDWG=S in the DDR), or a Specification Control Item (TYPDWG=C in the DDR).
children.content: Additionally, an MDR shall be prepared for any part or assembly that is a Design Control Repair Part (TYPDWG=D in the DDR) that has a suggested source of supply.

children.title: Document description record.
children.content: The record shall contain any of the following data that applies to the document:

children.title: DOCNUM - Document number.
children.content: The DOCNUM is the unique number used to identify that document.

children.title: CODIDT - Code identification.
children.content: Enter the appropriate code for the Contractor and Government Entity (CAGE). The codes are found in the Federal Supply Code for Manufacturers Handbook, H4-1 and H4-2.

children.title: PLCLASS - Parts list classification.
children.content: PLCLASS is a one letter code, applicable only to assemblies, representing the classification of the parts lists for the document. ("T" for top secret, "S" for secret, "C" for confidential, and "U" for unclassified.)

children.title: PLRLEV - Parts list revision level.
children.content: The PLRLEV is a one or two letter code representing the parts list revision level.

children.title: REVLEV - Revision level.
children.content: The REVLEV is a one or two letter code representing the graphics revision level.

children.title: NUMSHT - Number of sheets.
children.content: NUMSHT is a one to three digit value representing the total number of sheets of a document with a document number beginning with '0N'. (When the numbering of engineering documentation uses 0N, the character 0 is a numeric character.)

children.title: RIGHTS - Rights.
children.content: Rights is a single letter code representing the Government's rights to a document, ("L" for limited and "U" for unlimited).

children.title: DWGSIZ - Drawing size.
children.content: The DWGSIZ is a one letter code representing the dimensions of the drawing in accordance with 101.1 of DOD-STD-100.

children.title: SECDWG - Security classification of drawing.
children.content: SECDWG is a one letter code representing the classification of the document, (T, S, C, or U).

children.title: TITDOC - Title of document.
children.content: The TITDOC is a description of the document, as it appears in the title block of the document. Document titles shall be limited to 23 characters in length. Abbreviations in accordance with MIL-STD-12 shall be used.

children.title: TYPDWG - Type of drawing.
children.content:
TYPDWG is a one letter code describing Control drawings. The codes are:

A - Altered Item
V - Selected Item
S - Source Control
C - Specification Control
D - Design Control Repair Part

(NOTE: TYPDWG=D applies only to parts or assemblies which have a suggested source of supply and are not Altered, Selected, Source, or Specification Control Items.)

children.title: MRVLEV02-MRVLEV99 - Revision levels for multisheet documents.
children.content: MRVLEV02 through MRVLEV99 are one or two letter codes representing the revision levels for the second through the ninety-ninth sheets respectively of a multisheet document.

children.title: Part description record.
children.content: The record shall contain all of the following data as it applies to the part or assembly.

children.title: PRTDSC - Part description.
children.content: The PRTDSC is a description of the part as it appears in the title block or field of the document. Part descriptions shall be limited to 23 characters in length. Abbreviations in accordance with MIL-STD-12 shall be used.

children.title: MNTNON - Maintenance/non-maintenance.
children.content:
MNTNON is a one letter code, M or N.

M - Maintenance Part - A maintenance part is defined as any part or assembly which needs no further fabrication of finishing prior to replacing the part. Maintenance parts include all assemblies, all electrical components, all name, warning, and instruction plates, finished brackets, and fasteners. (NOTE: An exception to these rules is wire. Wire which must meet special requirements and or specifications will always be coded as a Maintenance Part, MNTNON=M.)

N - Non-Maintenance Part - A Non-Maintenance Part is defined as any part which must be further finished prior to replacement such as unfinished brackets which must be welded or drilled, bare printed wiring boards, or bulk material such as solder.

children.title: PRTNUM - Part number.
children.content: The PRTNUM is the unique number used to identify the part. In the event that specifications do not provide guidelines for assigning the part number, contact the contracting officer.

children.title: SECPRT - Security classification of part.
children.content: SECPRT is a one letter code applicable only to NSA assemblies and parts, (i.e. 0N DOCNUM) representing the security classification of the part. (T, S, C, or U).

children.title: Structure record.
children.content: The record shall contain any of the following data that applies to the part of reference document.

children.title: DOCUSE - Document use code.
children.content: DOCUSE is a two letter code which indicates whether the STR is for an assembly, subassembly, piece part, or a reference document. The Document Use Codes that will be used are in Table I.

children.title: NXTASY - Next (higher) assembly.
children.content: For a part or assembly, the NXTASY is the part number (PRTNUM) of the next higher assembly. For any reference document, the NXTASY is the document number (DOCNUM) of the drawing that references the reference document. For top assemblies, the NXTASY is the part number prefixed by the two letter code 'DL'. (see 10.5)

children.title: UNITSS - Units.
children.content:
UNITSS is a two letter code, applicable only to parts (piece parts and assemblies), representing the units of measurement for the part.

EA - EACH
FT - FEET
IN - INCHES
LB - POUNDS
CM - CENTIMETERS
MR - METERS
KG - KILOGRAMS
AR - AS REQUIRED

children.title: QTASY - Quantity in (next) assembly.
children.content: QTASY is a one to four digit number, applicable only to parts, representing the number of units of the part used in the next higher assembly.

children.title: PRTNUM - Part number.
children.content: (see 10.3.2.4) (NOTE: Structure Records for Reference Documents do not have a PRTNUM.)

children.title: FNDNUM - Find number.
children.content: FNDNUM is the find number of the part as it appears on the drawing of the next higher assembly.

children.title: REFDES - Reference designators.
children.content: The REFDES are the reference designators for the part or assembly as they appear on the drawing of the next higher assembly. (NOTE: One unique reference designator shall exist for each occurrence of the part or assembly on the next higher assembly (e.g. If a resistor is used ten times in an assembly (i.e. QTASY=10) then there will be ten Reference Designators, (R1, R2, --, R10)).)

children.title: Manufacturer's description record.
children.content: The record shall contain the following data:

children.title: VENCOD - Vendor code.
children.content: The VENCOD is a five digit CAGE code identifying the manufacturer of the part. The codes are found in the Federal Supply Code for Manufacturers Handbook, H4-1 and H4-2.

children.title: MFRPRT - Manufacturer's part number.
children.content: The MFRPRT is the unique number used by the manufacturer to identify the part.

children.title: The data required shall be on one magnetic tape that conforms with Federal Specification W-T-0051 requirements.
children.content: The tape shall be on a 9-track tape drive at a density of 1600 BPI. EBCDIC character code with odd parity shall be used. Each logical record shall be 258 characters long with 20 logical records per physical record, (i.e. 5160 characters per physical record). There shall be no internal tape marks. The tape shall be marked externally indicating the above specifications including which of the following formats are used.

children.title: Each top assembly shall have the following special DDR prepared in addition to the regular DDR described in 10.3.1.
children.content:
DOCNUM = DOCNUM of top assembly prefixed by the two letter code 'DL'
TITDOC = TITDOC of top assembly

children.title: Each top assembly shall have the following special PDR prepared in addition to the regular PDR described in 10.3.2.
children.content:
DOCNUM = DOCNUM of top assembly prefixed by the two letter code 'DL'
PRTNUM = PRTNUM of top assembly prefixed by the two letter code 'DL'
PRTDSC = PRTDSC of the top assembly
